verdict.rationale: WezTerm's configuration is plain-text Lua stored locally (not locked in a proprietary format or cloud service), and community evidence shows scrollback/session content can be dumped via `wezterm cli get-text`, giving a de facto path to extract your data and leave. However, there is no explicit documented 'export all data' feature, no bundled data-portability tool, and no discussion of migrating multiplexer session state elsewhere. Missing for 10: an explicit export/backup feature or documentation addressing full data portability beyond config files and scrollback dumps, and independent confirmation of leaving with all state intact.
